63:t_10:46.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... has gone... What will we do about someone to run the $$Ｄトレーダー$$?」

63:t_10:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well, I guess we have to... Shall we do it today?」

63:t_10:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, let's get down to...!」

64:t_000:0.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All units are in position.」

64:t_000:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$n! I'm leaving $$レド$$'s support to you!」

64:t_000:2.en:
$n
「So it ends up like this after all...」

64:t_000:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Are you jealous that someone took your friend?」

64:t_000:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「...It seems you and that $$チェインバー#pilot$$ fellow weren't discussing anything worthwhile.」

64:t_000:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Not at all. His approach as a Pilot Support Enlightenment Interface System gave me a great deal to learn from.」

64:t_000:8.en:
$$アル$$
「Yes. His role appears to be to develop his pilot into a fully fledged soldier.」

64:t_000:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I pity that man, $$レド$$, having someone you respect as his instructor.」

64:t_000:10.en:
$$アル$$
「I ask you to understand the misfortune of an AI partnered with someone stubborn who prefers inefficient operations, too.」

64:t_000:12.en:
$$アル$$
「It was a joke to ease the tension before the operation. This looks set to be our first large-scale battle in some time.」

64:t_000:14.en:
$$リジット$$
「Can you hear me, $$レド$$?」

64:t_000:15.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This appears to be a complex discussion, so I will speak as interpreter.」

64:t_000:16.en:
$$リジット$$
「Either is fine. Do you understand the purpose of this operation?」

64:t_000:17.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I understand. We intend to avoid killing or injuring anyone as much as possible.」

64:t_000:18.en:
$$リジット$$
「One more question. With your firepower, couldn't you destroy this entire $$ガルガンティア船団$$?」

64:t_000:19.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Affirmative. Leaving $c aside, this unit alone could wipe out the fleet.」

64:t_000:20.en:
$$リジット$$
「Then why try to help us when we're so vulnerable? I hear no one forced you to sortie.」

64:t_000:21.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...The person called $$ベローズ$$ told us that people here 'give fresh water to those who bring fish'. And that pirates do not honor those words.」

64:t_000:22.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Therefore, I judge that negotiation with you is possible.」

64:t_000:24.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「We wish to remain stationed here for a while. We want support to do so.」

64:t_000:25.en:
$$リジット$$
「...Understood. I will take responsibility for conveying your request to the Fleet Commander.」

64:t_000:26.en:
$n
「$$レド$$... What were you talking about?」

64:t_000:27.en:
$$レド$$
「We were talk-ing a-bout how to live here.」

64:t_000:30.en:
$n
「No... Sorry it took me so long to see it, but I was thinking you're just like us.」

64:t_000:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All personnel. I will command this operation.」

64:t_000:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「According to the reconnaissance report, the pirates' 《$$ユンボロ$$》 force vastly outnumbers ours.」

64:t_000:34.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our individual units are stronger, but we are overwhelmingly outnumbered, and we must protect the fleet at the same time.」

64:t_000:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「For the fleet's future, we also need to demonstrate our strength to the pirates.」

64:t_000:36.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「That's right. We'll knock down every enemy that approaches the fleet.」

64:t_000:37.en:
$$クルツ$$
($$テッサ$$ seems strangely tense, but isn't $$クルーゾー$$ awfully fired up too...?)

64:t_000:38.en:
$$マオ$$
(Never mind $$ベン$$, I'm a little worried about $$テッサ$$...)

64:t_000:39.en:
$$マオ$$
(I'm sure Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$ has noticed too, though...)

64:t_000:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Our main battlefield is the sea. I must win, if only to live up to Captain $$ジェフリー$$'s trust in giving me command.」

64:t_000:42.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(I may not have seen the Captain like this since her first battle...)

64:t_000:43.en:
$$マデューカス$$
(As I thought, these three months of fighting have exhausted her, both physically and mentally...)

64:t_000:44.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Pirate forces confirmed...! They're entering combat range!」

64:t_001:0.en:
$$ボス$$
「There's a hell of a lot of them!」

64:t_001:1.en:
$$ヌケ$$
「And they're underwater, where we're no good!」

64:t_001:2.en:
$$ムチャ$$
「Hold on! Why are there $$ネオ・ジオン$$ mobile suits mixed in too?!」

64:t_001:3.en:
$$パーラ$$
「They were excavated from a 《$$マウンテンサイクル$$》.」

64:t_001:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「Are those the ruins that were supposed to be all over 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》?」

64:t_001:5.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Yeah, that's right. Machines from the past are dug up there.」

64:t_001:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「What the hell does that mean? Sure, those amphibious machines are old, but they aren't pottery or fossils!」

64:t_001:7.en:
$$ガロード$$
「The world we came from was actually in the far future of the era when $$ジオン$$ existed.」

64:t_001:8.en:
$$ガロード$$
「It became part of 《$$ＵＣＷ$$》 in the $$大時空震動$$. That's why those things turn up in the ruins.」

64:t_001:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't care how they acquired them. First, we annihilate the enemy force.」

64:t_001:10.en:
$$アルト$$
「You do understand the plan, right, $$宗介$$?」

64:t_001:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I heard the Captain's plan. We will avoid killing or injuring enemy pilots as much as possible.」

64:t_001:12.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
[I can find no logical value in this course of action.]

64:t_001:13.en:
$$レド$$
[The operational commander decided it. We have no choice but to obey.]

64:t_001:14.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, intercept the pirates! Take them down one after another and show them our strength!」

64:t_001:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand. The enemy leader, $$ラケージ$$, is probably waiting in the rear.」

64:t_001:17.en:
$$テッサ$$
「And this battle won't end unless I defeat her, the woman they call the Empress.」

64:t_002:0.en:
$$ルカ$$
「A machine is approaching at high speed from the rear!」

64:t_002:1.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It seems our main target has arrived.」

64:t_003:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck is that huge $$ユンボロ$$?!」

64:t_003:2.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Warning. I infer that command unit is heading toward the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.」

64:t_004:0.en:
$$海賊$$
「It's been a long time since we got to see $$ラケージ$$ surfing!」
